About.paragraph: Results-driven QA Analyst and ISTQB® Certified Tester Foundation Level (CTFL) professional with hands-on expertise in Manual Testing, Test Automation, API Testing, and Accessibility Testing across web and RESTful API applications. Experienced in building scalable automation frameworks and executing functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing throughout the SDLC/STLC. Delivered measurable results by executing 150+ manual test cases, developing 80+ automation scripts, identifying 100+ critical and high-severity defects, and reducing regression testing effort by up to 40% through CI/CD-integrated automation. Strong in API testing, database validation, defect management, and collaborative quality engineering, with a focus on early defect detection, efficient testing, and reliable software delivery.

Testimonials.text: I build scalable test automation solutions that improve coverage, reduce repetitive testing, and provide fast, reliable feedback throughout the development lifecycle from UI and regression testing to end-to-end automation and CI/CD integration.

I ensure software quality through comprehensive manual testing, covering functional, regression, integration, and exploratory scenarios. I focus on identifying defects, validating functionality, and delivering reliable, user-friendly applications through effective test case design and execution.

I ensure APIs are reliable, secure, and production-ready through comprehensive functional and automated testing. I validate data, requests, responses, authentication, and integrations to catch critical issues early and deliver seamless system communication.

I ensure digital experiences are accessible and inclusive by identifying barriers that can impact users with disabilities. Through WCAG-focused testing, keyboard and screen reader validation, colour contrast, focus management, and accessible component testing, I help teams build products that are usable by everyone.

I develop robust Playwright automation to validate critical user journeys, improve regression coverage, and catch defects early. I focus on scalable, maintainable test suites with reusable components, reliable locators, cross-browser testing, and CI/CD integration.

I leverage modern QA tools and development practices to automate testing, improve coverage, accelerate feedback, and maintain quality throughout the development lifecycle. From Playwright, Selenium, and Cypress to Postman, Git, CI/CD, and Jira, I integrate the right tools to create efficient and scalable quality engineering workflows.
